description: Desktop download manager with multi-connection downloads, browser integration, and interrupted-transfer resume.
notes: The app payload is extracted from the NSIS package; the vendor setup is not run. Browser integration is registered per-user for Chrome, Edge and Firefox. The app database, logs, native-host manifests and WebView2 profile are redirected to this app's persist directory. Global installs skip browser integration; the publisher's WebView2 Runtime remains a system dependency.
